description: This file defines the class MidiPortWrapper, which provides a wrapper around MIDI device and port descriptions for an Android application. It manages details such as device info, port index, port type, and generates descriptive strings, along with equality and hash code implementations.

classes.name: MidiPortWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for representing a MIDI device port, including device info, port index, port type, and descriptive string representation.

methods.name: MidiPortWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with MIDI device info, port type, and port index.

methods.name: updateString
methods.description: Generates and updates the descriptive string for the MIDI port wrapper based on device properties and port info.

methods.name: findPortInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the specific port information matching the stored port index and type.

methods.name: getPortIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the port.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns the MIDI device information associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the descriptive string for the MIDI port wrapper.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this instance and another object based on device info, port index, and port type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on port index, port type, and device info.
